_doc: SAMPLE gift likes - the real list is not published (players learn it in game by asking). Tips: gold between tip.min and tip.max, taken whole; outside that range it is declined whole. Items: one unit of a listed type (or any subtype) is taken; the rest of a stack comes back. 'say' is what the NPC tells a player who asks what they like (and the hint on a wrong gift). personas = named NPCs by key / wanderers by persona key; roles = townsfolk, first match on their title or class name (a substring test on lower-case '<title> <ClassName>', first match wins, so order matters); default = everyone else (gold tips only). quirks = one odd extra like per NPC (not personas), dealt by a stable hash of the NPC's AI id. Unknown type names are logged and ignored.

default.say: a coin or two - it never goes amiss

mirabel.say: a bundle of candles for the common room
